title: reebime celsis abe
intro: Atu isih gorrissam caylale muucih xayyowte ayroora baxxaqsa. Tama num isinni misinkacaay, gadda kee ummattah fanat caddot yimixxige. qado astooti temeete wak, oson qaxmaqaane yaaxigeenih uxih xayyoysuk saduh dooren. macaay ta rooci diteh addat massoysam, kee keenik ellecaboh sarrimaane macak sugteeh?
clues: Anu mango gaddittee kee diihay luk barkat geeh, yi qangara koboxitteh addat qilsi abte.
Diini qangor kawseenih yanin wak, anu ken qangor ganam maduuda, takkay immay yi kaxxiina yoo mabta.
Anu inni fayseenit gaaboyseh, farmo edde baysan gital cubbusuh inni baxsimeh.
mango mablaak lakal, anu tu hinna iyyeh sugem takkay immay ' taturte waktik obteh tan intil bixa' sinam wonnah gacissuh.
maybalaalaqa tokkeek saanih yoo warse: ' Anu dubuk gine tiya lih yoo cab.' Anu inni ekraaroh dubuk yeyyeeqeh suge.
xayuk, kaxxam gira anu maabitina yoo yabbixe foocal alfenta, kee anu kudah mayyu.
